name: Rishabh Pant Looking For The Ball
visual_description: Wicketkeeper Rishabh Pant looks upward searching for the cricket ball while it drops right between his legs.
usage_context: Used to mock missing something obvious or searching everywhere for an item right under one's nose.

example.top_text: Me looking for my glasses while wearing them
